visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. The individual Monaco Cathedral exterior has a pale coursed Romanesque front with three deep round porches, rectangular wood portals beneath pale arched tympana, visible paired two-stage stone columns and connected capitals. The twelve-spoke wheel rose, three central lights, flanking window tiers, shallow blind arcades, raised central gable, abstract relief and supported roof figures join a red-tiled nave and aisles. Gabled transepts, high rounded apse, scalloped lower ambulatory and broad rounded east chapel lead to paired flat-capped rear belfries and an octagonal crossing lantern. A rounded front corner chapel/stair and small gray-roof polygonal turret distinguish the side. Corrected blocked district porches, hidden/disconnected porch supports, floating figures, blind arcades crossing gable edges, pilasters crossing aisle windows and entry stairs. Small street-tier fields are deliberately flat; closeup/master add their recesses. Fine carving, hidden rear details and all vertical dimensions remain estimates.
